## 1. Is the PDF Menu on Your Website an ADA Risk? How to Replace PDFs With Accessible Pages
- Target keyword: are PDFs on websites ADA compliant | Secondary: accessible PDF menu, PDF accessibility for websites
- Search intent: Informational
- Format: how-to guide + checklist
- Angle: Many small business sites still post menus, price lists, brochures, and forms as PDFs that screen readers can't read well. Show owners how to spot the risky ones, when to convert a PDF into a real web page instead of "fixing" the file, and what a designer does differently when rebuilding it, without making legal promises.
- Why now: A complaint filed 2026-10-02 in S.D.N.Y. lists "inaccessible Portable Document Formats (PDFs)" alongside missing alt text and unclear page titles among the cited WCAG failures — https://tdari.com/ada/ny/NY-74907808
- Volume / KD: unverified
- Effort: Low
- Outline starter:
  - H2: Why PDFs keep showing up in website accessibility complaints
  - H2: Which PDFs on a small business site matter most (menus, price lists, forms)
  - H2: Convert to a web page or remediate the PDF? A quick decision rule
  - H2: How to rebuild a PDF menu or brochure as an accessible page
  - H2: A 10-minute PDF audit you can run today

## 2. Free Ways to Check What ChatGPT and Google AI Mode Say About Your Business (Before You Pay for an AI Visibility Tool)
- Target keyword: how to check AI visibility of my business | Secondary: AI visibility tool for small business, does ChatGPT recommend my business
